subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and CLI-warning pieces are bounded, but the requested 200/503 endpoint behavior changes operator-facing deployment semantics for existing gateway health surfaces.

options.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
options.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a separate cron-only HTTP route.

options.title: Add Dedicated Cron Route
options.body: Implement `/health/cron` with explicit cron-only 200/503 semantics and treat it as a new public operator contract.

options.title: Defer Endpoint Semantics
options.body: Ship logs and cron-list warnings first, then decide endpoint behavior in a later design pass.

recommendation.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
recommendation.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a separate cron-only HTTP route.

likelyOwner.reason: He left the most detailed prior review context and is tied to adjacent cron and gateway cleanup history.
